messages:
karthik: Heads up — we’re seeing >50% packet loss to hosts in us-west-2b (GPU pool). Flows failing intermittently, also high TCP retransmits. Could require a partial AZ evacuation. tagging @maya oncall

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2345 — network-flap-usw2b. Priority: high.

maya: Copy. Jumping in. Any signs this is node-level (NIC) vs provider-level fabric?

karthik: Initial traceroutes from agent fleet show multiple hops timing out after the regional spine. Provider ticket open (PN-9876) but ETA unknown.

sasha: If we need to evacuate, let's do a soft/priority-based drain: cordon + evict low-priority / batch pods first, keep reserved Dedicated pools running if possible. Avoid a hard drain of GPU nodes unless packet loss persists.

ben: Capacity check: us-west-2a has ~30% headroom on GPU pool if we reclaim some burst; us-west-2c is ~15%. We can scale up nodepools but spot preemption risk increases cost volatility.

lee: Proposal: 1) Cordon affected nodes in 2b. 2) Scale up usw2a dedicated pool by +20 nodes (gpu-rt-ssd), enable burst autoscaler override. 3) Start eviction script for best-effort jobs. 4) Enable routing failover for public API traffic to usw2a/usw2c via NLB weight shift. 5) Keep long-running stateful jobs pinned (no cross-AZ move).

maya: Agreed. I'll enact cordon and start selective evictions. @sasha please monitor model-serving critical routes and confirm fallback routing.

sasha: On it. Running canary reroute to usw2a now. If latency or QPS spikes, we’ll throttle low-tier traffic first.

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary-route-update -> NLB weights adjusted (us-west-2a: 60%, us-west-2c: 30%, us-west-2b: 10%) by maya at 1802345690.

karthik: Running drain commands on nodepool gpu-usw2b-1 (soft evict, grace=120s). Commands used:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-23-usw2b
kubectl drain gpu-node-23-usw2b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
```

maya: Eviction script launched for best-effort pods (batch, internal experiments). It will skip pods with label "reserved=true" or "tier=critical".

ben: Autoscaler override applied: scaling gpu-usw2a-nodepool from 40 -> 60 nodes. API to cloud provider invoked. Watch for provisioning time (est 6-10m).

lee: Note: if provisioning lags, we should enable temporary cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 for low-priority embedding jobs only. That has cost implications — estimate +35% egress and storage penalties. Thoughts?

karthik: Let's avoid cross-region unless absolutely necessary. For now focus on intra-region p95 latency and preventing OOMs. We can fail low-priority background jobs to reduce pressure.

sasha: Observability: GPU pool utilization in us-west-2a jumped from 62% -> 88% after weight shift. Kernel CPU steal reported minimal. KV cache hit rates unchanged.

maya: Provider updated ticket PN-9876: "Investigating edge fabric anomaly affecting 2b, no ETA." They recommended rerouting to other AZs.

ben: Cost callout: if we keep the autoscaler override for >24h and keep extra nodes on, projected bill delta ~ +$18k/day. Recommend autoscaler policy revert to scale-down after stabilization.

lee: Add runbook step to set a budget-aware cooldown: revert override after 45m and allow scale-down to 30 nodes if traffic normalizes.

karthik: Good. I'll annotate incident with that. Also tagging infra-sre for possible host-level investigation later.

maya: Quick status: 1) cordon/drain started on 6 affected nodes, 2) autoscaler override +20 nodes initiated, 3) NLB weights adjusted, 4) eviction script completed first pass (removed ~80 batch pods).

sasha: Observed 10% error rate on low-tier APIs during the shift — throttling low-priority routes fixed the error spike. Critical model-serving unchanged.

ben: Cloud provider finally provisioned 18 nodes to us-west-2a (took ~8m). New nodes are registering, kubelet ready.

maya: Current estimate — stabilization in ~30m. If packet loss persists, we'll complete hard drain of remaining 2b nodes and route 0% traffic to 2b.

karthik: Action owners: cordon/drain = maya, routing weights = sasha, autoscaler override = ben, postmortem = maya.

lee: Will draft an ops note for cost and cross-region fallback policy.

maya: Thanks. Will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:

ben: ping me before we flip weights back so I can coordinate scale-down safely.

deploy-bot: incident update: NLB weights stable.

maya: Final update at 1802345715 — packet loss improved to baseline after partial evacuations, us-west-2b still degraded but healthy enough for reserved workloads. Leaving 2b drained for non-critical pods. Monitoring for 1h, then we'll close if stable.

karthik: Great work team. We'll do a follow-up postmortem with timeline and cost impact.
